sections.kicker: Prepared for Surfing Cowboys by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Surfing Cowboys has had a point of view since 1995. The hero shows hills, not the label.
sections.keep: "Made in Los Angeles. Found in California. Shipped from Malibu." Three places in one line give the label a real map.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The headline is a big promise over a landscape with no clothing in it.
pins.why: Only this label could write the line, and then the page shows empty hills instead of anything it makes.
pins.how: Put the label's own graphics where the hills are, so the line and its proof sit together.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: The strongest line on the page stays a slogan.

pins.quote: Vintage clothing, art & objects found along the way.
pins.what: The label also runs a vintage shop, an art corner and a home section, in the same breath.
pins.why: Original graphics and vintage finds are two different reasons to visit, and the front door never says which one leads.
pins.how: Decide which one is the front of the house and let the others support it.
pins.label: Your subline
pins.cost: A new visitor cannot tell if this is a label or a general store.

pins.quote: Original graphics. Easy California fits. Made close to home.
pins.what: The best proof of why Surfing Cowboys and not another beach label sits below the hero as a small line.
pins.why: Original graphics, made close to home since 1995, are what no other California label can copy.
pins.how: Move this promise up and show the graphics as the first thing on the page.
pins.label: Your collection
pins.cost: The graphics that set the label apart wait below the fold.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Surfing Cowboys. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and they point the same way.
